sentences.text: Adam Patrick DeVine -LRB- born November 7 , 1983 -RRB- is an American actor , comedian , singer , screenwriter and producer .
He is a star and co-creator of the Comedy Central series Workaholics , as well as Adam DeVine 's House Party .	Comedy Central	Comedy Central	Workaholics	Workaholics

Since 2013 , he has portrayed Andy Bailey , the boyfriend of Haley Dunphy , on the critically acclaimed hit ABC sitcom Modern Family .	Haley Dunphy	Haley Dunphy	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Modern Family	Modern Family
